title: Home
text:
Welcome to my portfolio for MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics at the University of Pennsylvania.
This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program — weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to urban policy questions.


I’m a student in the MUSA program at Penn. My background is in GIS, and I’m interested in sustainability and transportation.




Weekly Notes — what I’m learning each week
Assignments — analyses completed for the course
About — more background and how to reach me

title: Week 1: Getting Set Up
text: Today in class, our class made a repository from a template made by Prof. Delmelle. During class, I cloned my repository to GitHub Desktop and then opened and edited the files in RStudio. I edited the index markdown file which was a Quarto file. We went through the process of creating the website, as well as committing and pushing those changes onto github.com. Now I am editing the Week 1 Quarto markdown file with this text that you are reading now.

title: Week 1: Getting Set Up
text:
Reflection

I am someone who has been trying my best to avoid coding at all costs for a major portion of my life. However, as I completed my GIS degree, I realized how critical coding was, even if it didn’t take up a majority of how I completed my work. I am nervous to jump in the deep end of using R, but also excited about learning about the course material, especially creating prediction models.

title: About Me
text: My name is Yogi Patnaik and I am a Master of Urban Spatial Analytics student at the University of Pennsylvania. I completed my Bachelor’s degree in geographic information science (GIS) from Arizona State University. I have been fond of maps and how much information they hold since I was young. This inspired me to look into what more I could accomplish using that location data, which led me into becoming a GIS student. As a MUSA student, I wish to be even more creative with how I can analyze location data and be better able to use the various tools that are used in the realm of the urban spatial analytics program. My topics of interest when it comes to the spatial world is the design of better roadways and the creation of better urban sustainability patterns and sustainable transportation networks.
